summary.name: Letterpress Printing (Printmaking and Craft Materials). Supplemental provenance; not a directly named style in the source collection.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: thick paper, shallow debossed edges, natural ink coverage, simple typography and graphics, and soft side lighting that reveals the impression. Avoid exaggerated metallic bevels and deep embossed lettering.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: the combinations guidance says Letterpress alone suits short typographic statements and stationery. Inferred: invitations, cards, and craft stationery. Hybrids are suggested for longer editorial pages and product-style printed-object shots. Unspecified: any other use cases.
summary.limitations: Explicit: impressions must stay shallow, and deep embossing or bevels are excluded. Paper texture, ink coverage, depth, and lighting must be controlled separately. Simulated appearance is not evidence of physical production. Palette checks are two-color only, so readability over textures, images, or video must be rechecked in composited frames.
summary.palette: Suggested, not approved: background #F6EDD9 (cream paper), foreground #343932 (dark ink), accent_1 #914839 (restrained print accent). Task or brand colors override these. Inks stay discrete; gradients are disabled. Contrast: foreground on background is 10.147; background on accent_1 is 5.653. Re-verify in actual frames.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: animate typesetting, pressing, or localized reveals with restraint. Deliberate cuts, impacts, and reading holds are allowed; easing is not required for every transition. Video state derives from composition time. Scroll or hover behavior applies only to interactive delivery. Optional motion references are motion-012 (chaptered transition) and motion-015 (scroll storytelling), each only if the scene supports it; selecting none is valid.
summary.audio: Unspecified for this style; the source assigns no mandatory audio layer. Suggested options include music, voiceover, sung vocals, sound effects, ambience, or silence, chosen for topic and pacing. Honor user requirements and supplied assets first. Do not invent audio assets. Verify speech clarity, balance, no clipping, and picture sync.
summary.assetRequirements: Unspecified: no specific asset files are named. Needed inputs are glyph or graphic outlines for shallow impressions, plus paper texture and lighting inputs. Fonts and assets must load before rendering. Missing assets must be reported. Blender with Cycles or EEVEE, driven by Python bpy inside Blender, can generate the renders. Optional tldraw authoring exports SVG or raster.
summary.combinations: Suggested hybrids, not verified: style-019 adds page grid and serif/sans hierarchy for literary promos, publisher brands, and annual-report covers, with dark ink and one oxblood accent. Style-096 adds slow macro raking-light camera work for invitations, business cards, and stationery launches, avoiding gold sparkle and heavy blur.
summary.productionApproach: Explicit: HyperFrames is the primary composition and export pipeline, with a paused seekable GSAP timeline and npx hyperframes check, snapshot, and render commands. Remotion is only a conditional fallback, and the reason must be recorded. Blender is the style renderer and motion engine, with GSAP or chroma.js as optional supporting tools. Delivery requires checking opening, action, transition, and closing frames, loop seams, and audio sync.
